description: This file defines a sealed class 'PdfGenericAnnotation' within the 'PdfSharp.Pdf.Annotations' namespace. The class represents a generic PDF annotation, inheriting from 'PdfAnnotation', and is used for annotation dictionaries that are unknown to PDFsharp. It includes a constructor taking a 'PdfDictionary' and an internal nested class 'Keys' that defines dictionary keys metadata.
